title: CEA Industries Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: CEA Industries Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the Board approval of a 2026 Inducement Plan and the grant of 363,636 RSUs to newly appointed CFO William B. Miller, valued at approximately $1,000,000 as an inducement to accept employment. The RSUs vest 25% on the first anniversary with remainder vesting quarterly through the fourth anniversary, with accelerated vesting provisions upon qualifying terminations and change in control events.
key_points: CFO William B. Miller appointed effective March 9, 2026 per prior 8-K disclosure
Board approved 2026 Inducement Plan on April 6, 2026 authorizing up to 1,000,000 shares for new employee inducement grants
RSU grant of 363,636 shares with grant date fair value of approximately $1,000,000
Vesting schedule: 25% after year one, remainder in equal quarterly installments through year four
Termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason triggers pro-rata vesting
Death or Disability triggers full accelerated vesting
Change in Control with qualifying termination within 12 months triggers full accelerated vesting
